{{Quote|These Baktoid X-1 combat goggles show me everything. I never take them off.|Ovold|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''X-1 combat goggles''' was a [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] model manufactured by [[Baktoid Industries/Legends|Baktoid Industries]] and used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Engineer/Legends|Engineer]] [[Ovold]] showed a particular fondness for the goggles while on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] for their ability to warn him about the local predators such as [[Rakghoul]]s.
